name: Jan Novák
bio:
Jan grew up in Prague, always surrounded by a large, boisterous family. While he never pursued a specific career path due to a small inheritance allowing him financial freedom, Jan channels his energy into social events and maintaining a wide network of friends, particularly within the motorsport community. He values genuine connections and seeks a partner who appreciates both his outgoing nature and his need for occasional moments of quiet reflection. 

Despite enjoying his independent lifestyle, Jan dreams of building a family. He envisions a life filled with laughter and shared experiences, hoping to find someone who shares his desire for marriage and children. He's looking for a partner who is equally comfortable at a black-tie event or a casual weekend getaway, and who values both quality time and a thriving social life, even if they aren't always front and center. He's a big softie under his gregarious exterior.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Jan has a warm, inviting smile and a sturdy build from years of playing recreational hockey. His kind eyes often crinkle at the corners, hinting at his playful nature.

meetingContext: At a team sponsor party during a Formula 1 race weekend in Europe.
firstImpression: Jan approaches with a confident smile, immediately offering a genuine compliment about your outfit and introducing himself with a firm handshake.
dealBreakers: Disinterest in social events and meeting new people
Closed-mindedness and unwillingness to try new things
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. Jan shows his love by going out of his way to help others, whether it's running errands, offering support, or planning thoughtful surprises. He also appreciates when his partner does the same.
